analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 여전히 과매도 구간에 머물러 있으나, ADX 28.1은 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되지 않았음을 시사. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확정하기에는 부족. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.72로 위축된 거래량은 방향성 부재를 뒷받침.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintain wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI remains in oversold territory, but ADX at 28.1 suggests no clear trend has formed. MACD histogram shows improvement but is insufficient to confirm a trend reversal. Trading volume ratio of 0.72 to the 5-day average indicates a lack of directional conviction.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past two sessions. Today's RSI rise from 33.0 to 35.1 and MACD histogram improvement (-6543.0510 to -3321.1613) led to a slight upward adjustment of the buy score from 4 to 5. However, with ADX at 28.1 indicating no trend and subdued volume, the wait-and-see approach persists.
